review_notes: I read the whole file. It has no @[simp] attributes, so I looked for places where proofs work around a missing simp interface. I checked the definitions of finComponent, glFin, glArch and their *_apply lemmas in Definitions/Def_NumberField_AdelicLevel.lean. I also checked Mathlib's algebraMap_fst_apply, algebraMap_snd_apply and FiniteAdeleRing.algebraMap_apply. I did not search other files for conflicting simp rules. The suggestions to add @[simp] are based on how the lemmas are used and on the shape of the left-hand sides. I did not run Lean, so I have not tested whether they cause loops or conflicts, and I can't say whether the leftover `rfl`s would disappear.

findings.declaration: coe_finComponent_gammaPrime (and similar entrywise proofs: glArch_gammaPrime_partAt, coe_finComponent_glFin_centralScalar, glArch_centralScalar_eq_one)
findings.problem: The entrywise lemmas finComponent_apply, glArch_apply and glFin_apply are all proved by `rfl` but are not tagged @[simp]. Every proof here that goes through an entry of finComponent, glFin or glArch therefore has to bridge by hand with `have h : ... := rfl` or a `show`. Several of them then finish with `simp ... <;> rfl` or `simp; rfl`, so simp alone leaves goals that only `rfl` closes. This shows up in coe_finComponent_gammaPrime (the `have h ... := rfl`, then `simp [Matrix.diagonal]` followed by `rfl` in three of the four cases), glArch_gammaPrime_partAt, coe_finComponent_glFin_centralScalar and glArch_centralScalar_eq_one. The same `simp; rfl` pattern is repeated in hM1 in `solution`.
findings.proposed_change: Mark finComponent_apply, glArch_apply and glFin_apply as @[simp] in Def_NumberField_AdelicLevel. Alternatively, add `attribute [local simp] NumberField.AdelicLevel.finComponent_apply NumberField.AdelicLevel.glArch_apply NumberField.AdelicLevel.glFin_apply` in this file. Then drop the `have h ... := rfl`/`show` bridges. Their left-hand sides have the distinct heads finComponent, glArch and glFin applied to a matrix entry, and the right-hand sides are projections of the original entry, so no rewrite cycle is apparent. Together with a Mathlib-normal-form lemma for algebraMap on adele entries (see the third finding), most trailing `<;> rfl` should become unnecessary.
findings.benefit: Entry-wise computations about finComponent, glFin and glArch of GL₂ elements would normalise to the underlying adele entries under plain `simp`. The `show`/`rfl` boilerplate and the fragile `simp; rfl` endings go away, and later files that repeat the same bridging benefit too.

findings.problem: These `coe_*` lemmas compute the matrix of the file-local definitions gammaPrime and centralScalar, but none is @[simp]. Each consumer has to name the lemma explicitly. For example `rw [coe_gammaPrime, coe_gammaPrime]` in glArch_gammaPrime_partAt, `rw [coe_centralScalar]` in coe_finComponent_glFin_centralScalar and glArch_centralScalar_eq_one, and `rw [coe_gammaPrime]` in hM1. Without them, the proofs of the lemmas themselves have to unfold the definitions with `simp [gammaPrime, AutomorphicForm.centralScalar, diagUnits2, Matrix.GeneralLinearGroup.scalar, Matrix.mul_apply, Fin.sum_univ_two]`, which is the unwanted expansion a simp-normal coe lemma would avoid. In perClass_main, `hcmv` (around line 706) restates coe_finComponent_glFin_centralScalar verbatim just to rewrite with it.
findings.proposed_change: Mark coe_gammaPrime, coe_centralScalar and coe_finComponent_glFin_centralScalar as @[simp]. The left-hand sides have the heads `↑(gammaPrime ..)`, `↑(centralScalar ..)` and `finComponent .. (glFin .. (centralScalar ..))`, which are not themselves simp-expanded, so a rewrite loop is not apparent. Keep gammaPrime opaque to simp, with coe_gammaPrime as its only unfolding rule. Then the explicit `rw [coe_gammaPrime, ...]` calls and the local `hcmv` restatement can be removed.
findings.benefit: Matrix-entry goals about gammaPrime and centralScalar would simplify through one canonical rule instead of per-proof unfolding of definitions. The long `simp [gammaPrime, centralScalar, diagUnits2, ...]` lists and the duplicated `hcmv` statement become unnecessary.

findings.problem: The file states its results with `algebraMap K (v.adicCompletion K) x`. Mathlib's simp lemmas for the adele algebra map, AdeleRing.algebraMap_snd_apply and FiniteAdeleRing.algebraMap_apply, give `(x : v.adicCompletion K)` in coe form. The two forms are not unified, and the unit-wise form `((Units.map (algebraMap ..) u : (AdeleRing ..)ˣ) : AdeleRing ..).2 v` has no simp rule at all. As a result the file proves the same `rfl` identity as one-off local `have`s: `huAv` here, and the `he` step inside `hfin` in perClass_main, and it leaves `simp; rfl` endings in hM1. There is no canonical simp form connecting `algebraMap K (v.adicCompletion K) x` to the unit-valued adele components.
findings.proposed_change: Add one top-level lemma such as `@[simp] theorem snd_units_map_algebraMap_apply (x : Kˣ) (v) : (((Units.map (algebraMap K (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K) : K →* AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K) x : (AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K)ˣ) : AdeleRing (𝓞 K) K).2 : FiniteAdeleRing (𝓞 K) K) v = algebraMap K (v.adicCompletion K) (x : K) := rfl`. Pair it with a simp lemma that normalises either the `algebraMap K (v.adicCompletion K)` form or the Mathlib coe form, so the two do not compete. Replace `huAv` and `he` with it. Check separately that it does not compete with Mathlib's algebraMap_snd_apply on non-unit expressions.
findings.benefit: A single canonical rule replaces repeated local `rfl` facts. Goals about the finite-adele components of embedded units in `solution` and perClass_main would simplify uniformly, and the trailing `rfl` calls could probably be removed.
